title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: proximity join for attendees of Teams events
summary: The rollout, default state, licensing background and Bluetooth control are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The portal path and XML element are valid. One minor correction would acknowledge another Microsoft planning page that also conflicts with the comparison table's Android support listing.

claims.claim: Attendee proximity join is being added for Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android

claims.claim: Attendee proximity join is being added for Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android

claims.quote: during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

claims.claim: The notice describes connecting to nearby room systems with fewer steps.
claims.quote: This enhancement simplifies the meeting join experience and helps users connect to the appropriate room device with fewer steps.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on 4 November 2026 at 00:02:09.
Microsoft Learn has no page specifically describing attendee proximity join in events at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "attendee proximity join" "Teams"; Teams events attendee proximity join Teams Rooms town halls webinars licensing meter admin switch policy PowerShell. Opened proximity-join and the meetings/events and device comparison pages; no dedicated event proximity page found.

claims.claim: General proximity join lets desktop or mobile Teams users invite or nudge a Teams Room into a Teams meeting.
claims.quote: Proximity Join is a feature that lets end users use the Teams app on a desktop or mobile device to invite or nudge a Microsoft Teams Room into a Teams meeting.

claims.claim: General proximity join uses Bluetooth discovery.
claims.quote: Rooms discovered through Bluetooth are sorted by signal strength in descending order

claims.claim: Ultrasound proximity signaling is available on Teams Rooms on Windows with compatible consoles.
claims.quote: Ultrasound signaling is available on Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows (from compatible consoles)

claims.claim: Microsoft has not said every detail of the general proximity join page applies unchanged to events.
claims.quote: Searched: "attendee proximity join" "Teams"; Teams Rooms proximity join events external anonymous lobby attendee data roster automatic join. Read proximity-join, event comparison and device comparison; none states all meeting details apply unchanged to events.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Event participants will be able to connect to nearby Teams Rooms when joining an event.
claims.quote: Users will be able to use proximity join to connect to nearby Microsoft Teams Rooms when joining Teams events.

claims.claim: The general proximity join documentation requires Bluetooth enabled on the room device.
claims.quote: Bluetooth must be enabled on both the Teams Rooms device and on the client desktop/mobile endpoint in order for proximity to function.

claims.claim: The general proximity join documentation requires Bluetooth enabled on the desktop or mobile client.
claims.quote: Bluetooth must be enabled on both the Teams Rooms device and on the client desktop/mobile endpoint in order for proximity to function.

claims.claim: Proximity join communication takes place through Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: all communication takes place through Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Proximity join does not require a direct network connection between the personal device and the room device.
claims.quote: Proximity join doesn't require a direct network connection between a user personal devices and the Teams Rooms device

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described extra attendee or room data sent specifically by proximity join in events.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "proximity join" "events" "attendee information" "automatically"; read proximity-join and attendance-report and room-audio roster search excerpts. General meeting grouping is described, not extra data sent by event proximity join.

claims.claim: The Bluetooth discovery signal can pass through walls.
claims.quote: However, this signal can penetrate through walls.

claims.claim: Rooms discovered through Bluetooth are sorted by signal strength.
claims.quote: Rooms discovered through Bluetooth are sorted by signal strength in descending order

claims.claim: Bluetooth discovery includes rooms both in use and not in use.
claims.quote: it includes all Teams Rooms both in use and not in use.

claims.claim: General proximity join nudges must come from the same tenant or a trusted external organisation.
claims.quote: Proximity Join nudges from a desktop or mobile client must come from a user within the same tenant or from a trusted external organization.

claims.claim: General proximity join fails if the participant cannot bypass the Teams meeting lobby.
claims.quote: if the meeting participant using proximity join from their device is unable to bypass the Teams Meeting lobby, the proximity join will fail

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The same proximity nudge restrictions have not been explicitly documented for external or anonymous event attendees.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms proximity join events external anonymous lobby attendee data roster automatic join. Read proximity-join and who-can-bypass-meeting-lobby excerpt; lobby applies only to events up to 1,000 attendees, with no event proximity nudge rules stated.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Android Bluetooth use is limited to advertising beacons and prompted proximal connections.
claims.quote: Bluetooth technology use on Teams Rooms on Android devices is currently limited to advertising beacons and prompted proximal connections.

claims.claim: There is no Bluetooth device pairing as part of those Android features.
claims.quote: There's no Bluetooth device pairing as part of these features.

claims.claim: No autonomous or AI action is described for attendee proximity join.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "proximity join" "events" "attendee information" "automatically". Read the roadmap, MC1461157, proximity-join and release-note excerpts; these describe user nudges, not autonomous or AI actions for this feature.

claims.claim: The attendee uses proximity join to bring a nearby room into the event.
claims.quote: Users will be able to use proximity join to connect to nearby Microsoft Teams Rooms when joining Teams events.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe rooms joining events on their own without an attendee action.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "proximity join" "events" "attendee information" "automatically". Read MC1461157, proximity-join, device-settings-available and release-note excerpts; automatic acceptance follows an invitation, not room-initiated event joining.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Ultrasound proximity join is not currently available on Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: Proximity Join using ultrasound isn't currently available for Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Microsoft cautions that people or animals with sensitive hearing may hear ultrasound tones.
claims.quote: People or animals with sensitive hearing may be able to hear the ultrasound tones.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included within the Teams Rooms licences described in the briefing.
claims.quote: The following tables compare the Teams Rooms Basic and Teams Rooms Pro licenses and show what features are available with each.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Joining Teams meetings with 1-touch, proximity and meeting ID is listed under both Teams Rooms Basic and Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: | **Join Teams meetings with 1-touch, proximity, and meeting ID** | ✔ | ✔ |

claims.claim: A shared meeting device requires a Teams Rooms licence.
claims.quote: A device used as a shared meeting device requires a Teams Rooms license whether it participates by signing in to a Microsoft Teams client, by anonymous join, or by authenticating a Microsoft 365 identity

claims.claim: Enterprise per-user Microsoft 365 suite licences are not authorised for shared meeting devices.
claims.quote: Enterprise per user Microsoft 365 suite licenses aren't authorized for use on shared meeting devices in any of these configurations.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate licence specific to attendee proximity join in events has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "proximity join" "events" "license" "meter". Opened rooms-licensing, events-licensing, proximity-join and meetings-events-feature-comparison; read roadmap and MC1461157. Product licences and Windows Pro event support are stated, not a separate proximity licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate meter or charge specific to attendee proximity join in events is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "proximity join" "events" "license" "meter"; Teams events attendee proximity join Teams Rooms town halls webinars licensing meter admin switch policy PowerShell. Opened rooms-licensing, events-licensing and proximity-join; read roadmap and notice; no separate meter stated.

claims.claim: The comparison footnote says only Teams Rooms on Windows with Pro are officially supported as meeting or event presenters or attendees.
claims.quote: Only Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with a Pro license are officially supported to join meetings and events as a presenter or as an attendee.

claims.claim: The same comparison table lists Teams Rooms on Android as able to join as an attendee or presenter, in conflict with its footnote.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams Rooms (Android) can join as an attendee or presenter
claims.fix: After the existing conflict sentence, add: 'The Plan for Teams events page also lists Teams Rooms on Android as having "No support" for joining large-audience events as a presenter or attendee (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/plan-events#reference).' Cite that page.
